metadata.description: tebzira: agent skills, blended in Marrakech. Each one a recipe proven on real work.

plugins.name: site-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrades a company, product or personal website into a premium, truthful site, end to end: truth audit, brand-derived direction, signature moments, a contact form that delivers, SEO and web standards, real-browser verification with a scored critique, and reviewable PRs.

plugins.name: dev-guide
plugins.description: Writes a textbook-style developer guide for any repository and typesets it as a real book: linked Markdown pages, PDF and Word editions, and a publisher-grade cover with a public-domain plate. Every fact checked against the code.

plugins.name: dashboard-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrades an app dashboard or back office built for one operator into a reliable, premium tool: maps their real day, fixes broken actions and money bugs first, builds forms that never lose input and errors they can report, reshapes screens around their tasks, adds one signature moment, and verifies in a real browser against a local database.
